Biome: Plains — the village shore: tents scattered here and in the Harbour (pod 15), NO fence between them

Task: Queue up 10 trees for felling (Option+click — the queue lesson) and fell 10 trees — the RIVER GATE then opens: wade in at the chamber-wall gap (the spring rises hard against the centre wall — no walking behind it) and ride the current down through the gate to the Cove (no dry road)
Brace yourself in the water (hold Shift in the current), then catch 10 whitebait; the river below the gate runs fence-free to the sea

GOALS: light the furnace (wield the knife, strike the flint, stoke with logs; mānuka rākau + Firemaking 3 for iron heat) and forge the four pieces — iron shortsword, 300 iron arrowheads, bronze chainbody, bronze targe. Equipping is advised but NOT required. The terrace is an EXACT ore ledger (only ore on the isle; natural rocks stripped): 11 copper rocks x6 ore = 66 (46 copper bars + 20 for bronze; mining xp crosses Ore-mining 2 at ore 22 and 3 — the iron rock req — at ore 39), 2 tin rocks x5 = 10 (two 5-bar bronze batches), 5 iron rocks x5 = 25 (five 5-bar iron batches; the forge spends ~22). 46x20 + 10x25 = 1170 xp = Smelting 3
Skills Unlocked: Stone-mining, Ore-mining, Gem-mining, Smelting, Weaponsmithing, Armoursmithing, Firemaking

Task: The motu errand: swim to the offshore islet (seated PER CHARACTER just past bare-lungs range — equip the snorkel or drown a few strokes short; no hull can cross), open the sea chest, bring the pearl back TO VRIXA. Riding the river to its Source stays optional
Deposit an item; saw planks & make 15 empty pails at the carpenter's bench

The fenced 5x5 farm at the crown centre (one gate, east side): harvest 50 EACH of wheat, potatoes, apples, sageleaves & flax — a row of 5 ripe plots per crop, so REPLANTING and regrowing (~3 min/cycle) is required; mill 50 flour; collect 10 eggs; collect 100 feathers (= exactly the fletching budget for 300 arrows)
Skills Unlocked: Cerealiculture, Olericulture, Pomiculture, Herbiculture, Fibriculture, Milling, Husbandry

Task: Cut 300 arrow shafts (20 cuts — lands Fletching 2, the level iron arrows demand), fletch 300 iron arrows (20 batches: 15 shafts + 5 feathers + 15 heads), carve a shortbow (the arrow XP lands Fletching 3 for it). NO wand — magic is not taught on the isle
Cook 5 whitebait fritters, 1 cottage cheese (milk the cows with your pails — Husbandry 3), 5 flatbread (your flint from the Forge lights the fires)
Slay 3 slimes; gather 3 tallow, 3 hide, 3 action runes, 3 state runes; slay 5 koreke on the wing (archery)
Char your logs into wood ash, boil soap with your warden's tallow, and scrub off all your stink

Sky After: 6:15pm clear (dusk settles — from here on, finished keepers walk home to the Harbour Village and its lamps light one by one)

Task: Spin harvested flax into linen & wick, dip a rushlight, and equip it
Craft 50 air runes at the runestone altar (Runecrafting — no spellcasting taught)

Biome: Plains — the village shore, continuous with the Landing (no fence)
Task: Ferry to Newhaven (no task). The village green holds the keepers' tents; everyone met through the day gathers here after dusk
